description.zh: 文本生成 CAM：把 text-to-cad 的产物变成机床程序。目前支持 cut2d：DXF → 激光/等离子切割 G-code（GRBL、LinuxCNC、Fanuc），带切缝补偿、先内后外排序、引入线、行程检查和预览 SVG。先用 apply_skill 应用 cam 技能。只在工作目录写文件，从不连接机床。
description.en: Text-to-CAM: turn text-to-cad output into machine programs. Currently cut2d: DXF to laser/plasma cutting G-code (GRBL, LinuxCNC, Fanuc) with kerf compensation, inside-out ordering, lead-ins, bed check and a preview SVG. Apply the cam skill first with apply_skill. Only writes files in the workspace and never connects to a machine.

action.description: cut2d：把工作目录里的 DXF 轮廓转成激光/等离子切割 G-code（切缝补偿、先内后外、引入线），同时生成预览 SVG。铣削（mill）后续加入

input.description: 工作目录内的 .dxf 文件（ASCII DXF，单位取 $INSUNITS）

output.description: 输出 G-code 路径，默认与输入同名 .nc；预览写在旁边的 .preview.svg

machine.description: 机床配置：字段：controller(grbl/linuxcnc/fanuc/generic)、process(laser/plasma)、bed [x,y] mm、max_power（激光 S 最大值，默认 1000）、laser_mode(dynamic=M4/constant=M3)、z_axis、safe_height/pierce_height/cut_height、torch_on/torch_off（自定义 M 代码，如 QtPlasmaC 的 "M3 $0 S1"）、rapid、name

machine_file.description: 工作目录内的 JSON 文件，内容同 machine（已保存的机床配置）

job.description: 本次材料/工艺参数（覆盖 machine 同名字段）：kerf 切缝宽 mm、feed 进给 mm/min、power 激光功率 S、pierce_delay 穿孔延时 s、lead_in 引入线长 mm、overcut 过切 mm、origin(drawing/lower_left)、layers 只切这些图层、engrave_layers 沿线雕刻不补偿的图层、engrave_power、engrave_feed、tolerance 曲线拟合精度 mm。feed/kerf/power/pierce_delay 必须来自用户，不得猜测

job_file.description: 工作目录内的 JSON 文件，内容同 job

action.description: cut2d: turn DXF profiles in the workspace into laser/plasma cutting G-code (kerf compensation, inside-out order, lead-ins) plus a preview SVG. Milling (mill) comes later

input.description: a .dxf file in the workspace (ASCII DXF; units from $INSUNITS)

output.description: G-code output path, default the input name with .nc; the preview goes next to it as .preview.svg

machine.description: machine profile: Fields: controller (grbl/linuxcnc/fanuc/generic), process (laser/plasma), bed [x,y] mm, max_power (laser S maximum, default 1000), laser_mode (dynamic=M4/constant=M3), z_axis, safe_height/pierce_height/cut_height, torch_on/torch_off (custom M-code, e.g. QtPlasmaC "M3 $0 S1"), rapid, name

machine_file.description: a JSON file in the workspace holding the machine object (a saved machine profile)

job.description: material/process settings for this job (override machine fields of the same name): kerf mm, feed mm/min, power laser S, pierce_delay s, lead_in mm, overcut mm, origin (drawing/lower_left), layers to cut only these layers, engrave_layers cut on the line without compensation, engrave_power, engrave_feed, tolerance curve fit mm. feed/kerf/power/pierce_delay must come from the user, never guessed

job_file.description: a JSON file in the workspace holding the job object
